notes.title: Smug Test Update 2
notes.content:
Sup Smugglers.

New Patch Notes just dropped for the Smug Testers:

Gameplay:
- sweep up bodies with slide (slide is very op now)

Tweaks:
- fix big headed keruru blocking camera
- fix ragdoll kill credit
- passively regen stamina in combat
- more slide steering
- fix that one part where you drop down the exit
